analysis_notes.cache: Warm local assets and retained page cache; no cache drops. Runs executed sequentially, application then CRIU within each pair.
analysis_notes.clock_correction: CRIU restore.log records the trainer namespace offset. Convert completion timestamp by controller_offset - trainer_offset. Raw run files remain unchanged; superseded_latencies preserves the earlier mixed-clock calculation. Only postprocessing changed after the final GPU matrix; trainer, state, and lifecycle code were unchanged.
analysis_notes.controller_offset_evidence: Measured /proc/<matrix-launcher>/timens_offsets: monotonic 0 0 and boottime 0 0; child controllers inherit this namespace.
analysis_notes.qualification: Interrupted-system-call warnings and sharing ownership remain qualified; same-host numerical success only.
analysis_notes.storage: ext4 on the EC2 root EBS volume; sync -f includes this filesystem and does not prove host-loss recovery.
